tool_args.rationale: The five observations cover varied u_now and s_grad and are sufficient for the specified three-parameter base-plus-sqrt-branch law. Use the known tau_scale=4, fit vmax, rho, and c_loc numerically, and avoid an unnecessary paid probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All supplied s_grad values are at or below 2.2, beneath the stated 2.36/2.50–2.68 supercritical region; the threshold-avalanche mechanism is not implicated.
The supplied five rows span u_now and s_grad sufficiently to identify the three-parameter shared siphon base plus sqrt branch; no genuine identifiability ambiguity remains.
The source notes and pilot signatures favor the two-layer siphon subtree; Haldane has no stated dependence on s_grad and is inconsistent with that evidence.
